agent_explanation: Proportional controller computes raw force kp*velocity-error (+ noise) ~160 N but fails to clamp to fmax 123.3 N before applying/checking. Initial velocity (0,5.72) vs desired velocity toward waypoint (15.7,9.8) at vcmd 2.85 gives error magnitude ~6.6 m/s; times kp 28.7 gives ~190 N raw, observed 160.29 N after noise/geometry, exceeding limit. Raising fmax above raw force removes violation, confirming missing/incorrect saturation.
